papers.title: NAMVIS: Next-Scale Autoregressive Multi-View Image Synthesis
papers.abstract: A diffusion-free method for sparse-view multi-view synthesis that uses geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression. It reports better PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS than diffusion baselines and runs over 3x faster.

papers.title: Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching
papers.abstract: Fine-tunes flow policies with off-policy Q-learning, using a closed-form scalar adjoint that avoids per-step Jacobian products plus a value penalty. Tested on OGBench and a real bimanual robot.

papers.title: MIMESIS: Learning User Simulators as Training Environments for Interactive Agents
papers.abstract: A user simulator trained on human conversations with reasoning supervision and realistic behavior patterns. It is used to train agents with multi-turn RL and a coached self-distillation method.

papers.title: A self-learning scientific agent for X-ray diffraction
papers.abstract: An agent for powder X-ray diffraction that turns analytical experience into validated executable skills without retraining the language model. It leads on phase identification benchmarks.

papers.title: Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: A 3B pixel-space text-to-image transformer, plus tests on depth estimation and super-resolution. It finds no clear gain from a pixel-space generative prior over latent models.

papers.title: Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts
papers.abstract: Delta-MOPD transfers each teacher's logit shift relative to its base model rather than its endpoint policy. This improves multi-teacher on-policy distillation in both composed and routed settings.

papers.title: Inherit-MAS: Test-Time Evolution of Multi-Agent Systems through Workflow and Execution Inheritance
papers.abstract: Evolves LLM multi-agent workflows at test time by inheriting workflow structure and reusing matched execution results. It improves benchmark scores while reducing token usage.

papers.title: CoDance: Learning Reactive and Compliant Human-Humanoid Interaction from Video
papers.abstract: Learns reactive, compliant partnered dancing between a humanoid and a human from a single video, using multi-link compliance augmentation. Demonstrated on a physical humanoid.

papers.title: FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment
papers.abstract: Distills large vision-language-action robot policies into compact few-step students. On LIBERO it keeps most of the teacher's performance while cutting inference latency substantially.

papers.title: DSReg: Provably Recovering Individual World Latents without Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Recovers individual world latents from JEPA-style representations without a decoder or reconstruction. It relies on a Structural Diversity condition and applies post hoc to trained checkpoints.

What's changed

- Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through
- Added Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) support: terminals that implement it can show whether Claude Code is working, waiting on you, or done
- Added quoted text to the `/copy` picker, so a drafted message copies without its `>` markers
- Added a warning to `claude plugin install`, `enable`, `disable` and `marketplace add` when the settings file they write to does not load

What's changed

- Fixed `prompt` and `agent` hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block
- Improved how `prompt` hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early

What's changed

- Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K)
- Added `agentType` to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so scripts can tell custom subagent types apart
- Added `isDeferred` to `$.tool.register` for mods: `false` lists the tool's schema in the prompt from the start instead of behind tool search
